headline: LAA @ ARI matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is LAA 4.50 at ARI 3.55, with a projected total of 8.05. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward LAA: LAA moved +0.14 runs while ARI moved -0.31, changing the projected margin by +0.45 runs. NRFI probability dropped -10.0%, so the first-inning read became more YRFI/early-scoring friendly. Pitching context: Reid Detmers has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 2.6 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Jo Adell, Gabriel Moreno, Geraldo Perdomo, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Ildemaro Vargas, Zach Neto because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
